title: Hugh Jackman not wrong to be ‘concerned’ about Woodside gas project near WA reef, Murray Watt says
summary_full: Environment minister says he understands concerns about potential impact after 150 scientists and celebrities urged the government to block the projectGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastThe environment minister, Murray Watt, has acknowledged concerns raised by scientists and celebrity campaigners, including Hugh Jackman, about a contentious Woodside offshore gas proposal in northern Western Australia, saying he “absolutely understands” why they think it could have “very serious impacts” on nature.The federal government is expected to make a decision on whether to approve the Browse gas development near Scott Reef, about 300km off the Kimberley coast, under national environment law early next year.Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...
